name: Glitch Walk
hook: You step forward — and the universe drops frames.
description: A confident forward walk interrupted by hard stutters, frozen mid-stride poses and broken-signal body corrections. It reads instantly as a glitch, even with the sound off.

movement.firstSecond: Frame zero is a hard freeze mid-stride. Within 0.8s the body snaps forward through three stutter-steps, each one landing on a dead stop.
movement.signature: The Buffer: one foot lifted, head tilted about 30°, arms locked at mismatched angles, held perfectly still for 0.6s before snapping back to normal walking.

sequence.name: Hard freeze
sequence.description: Start frozen mid-stride, arms locked. Snap forward through three stutter-steps, each ending in a dead stop.

sequence.name: Signal drop
sequence.description: Walk forward normally; every second step the torso jerks back a few centimetres as if frames were dropped, then resumes.

sequence.name: Buffer
sequence.description: Full freeze: lifted foot, tilted head, mismatched arm angles. Hold 0.6s.

sequence.name: Rewind
sequence.description: Three choppy steps backwards at double speed.

sequence.name: Correction
sequence.description: The body recalibrates: head, shoulders, then hips each snap back to centre in sequence.

sequence.name: Resume
sequence.description: Smooth forward walk that decelerates into the opening mid-stride freeze.

movement.loopPoint: The final step lands in the same mid-stride freeze as frame zero, so the clip loops without a visible seam.
movement.cameraGuidance: Locked-off camera at chest height, performer walks toward the lens and stays fully in frame (head to feet) for the whole take.
transferConsiderations: Freezes must be truly static in the reference; micro-drift reads as model jitter, not intent.
Keep total forward travel under ~1.5m so the performer never leaves frame or changes scale dramatically.
Avoid arm-over-face occlusion during the Buffer pose.

recipe.prompt: The person from the photo performs a stop-start glitch walk toward the camera in a clean, evenly lit space. Preserve their face, body shape, hair and clothing exactly. Stable, locked-off camera. Crisp freezes, no motion blur on held poses.

provenance.notes: Original concept created for TREND MACHINE launch. Not derived from any specific existing viral trend.

rights.notes: No music is bundled. Audio is handled separately from movement.
